what: The harness releases the rules-at-scale eval runs (plan decision H: the newest release of each harness), read 2026-11-19 UTC from each package registry and release page named per entry. agents_rules.py installs these versions through the frontier Harbor classes and refuses a container whose installed version or binary differs (pin-check.ts). scripts/frontier-harbor/pin.json, pinned by another preregistration, is not changed: agents_rules.py reads its model limits and adds these versions beside its own entries in memory at run time.

claude-code.install: Harbor ClaudeCode.install (bootstrap.sh 2.1.328, the native binary); FrontierClaudeCode then requires the installed binary's sha256 to equal native_binary_sha256

codex.source: npm view @openai/codex dist-tags.latest 0.171.0 and dist.integrity, read 2026-11-22 for the GPT-6.2 Sol amendment (0.170.0 was the 2026-11-19 pin)

max_context_window.source: codex-rs/models-manager/models.json at rust-v0.171.0: gpt-6.2-sol context_window 500000 and max_context_window 872000, so the window the frontier path sets (872000) still holds

hermes.source: api.github.com/repos/NousResearch/hermes-agent/releases/latest (v0.23.2) and git ls-remote refs/tags/v0.23.2^{}. Hermes moved from date tags (the newest, v2026.9.24, is the frontier pin) to v0.x tags; the v0.23.2+canary.* tags are pre-releases and are not used
hermes.python: 3.14 (pyproject.toml gates every core dependency on python_version >= '3.14'; .python-version and scripts/install.sh default to 3.14)
hermes.install: agents_rules.py RulesHermes.install: the commit's own scripts/install.sh with --skip-setup --hermes-home /tmp/hermes --branch main --commit <commit> (the installer checks that the commit is an ancestor of origin/<branch>, so a tag name is refused with 'commit ... is not on branch v0.23.2'; the tag's commit is on main, GitHub compare behind_by 0 on 2026-11-19), then the anthropic extra through Hermes's own package manager (pm.ensure_import('anthropic')); the check reads anthropic from the environment pm committed

anthropic.source: uv.lock and the anthropic optional extra in pyproject.toml at the commit; installed by pm.ensure_import, which the default install does not do

hermes.integrity: the git commit sha (a tag can move; the commit cannot); the install refuses any other HEAD

openclaw.source: npm view openclaw (dist-tag latest 2026.11.5; 2026.10.33, published later, is a backport on the older line)
openclaw.engines: node >=24.16.0 <25 || >=26.1.0, so the frontier path's Node 24 still fits
openclaw.install: Harbor OpenClaw.install on Node 24 (FrontierOpenClaw): npm install -g openclaw@2026.11.5

gemini-cli.role: descriptive row of the keyless delivery map only; no paid cell (plan decision E)

changed_from_frontier_pin: Claude Code 2.1.312 to 2.1.328: a new native binary sha256. Nothing our wiring reads changed; the startup CLAUDE.md still loads whole (delivery map).

Codex 0.165.0 to 0.170.0: on a cut AGENTS.md, 0.170.0 prints 'warning: Loaded only 32768 of N bytes ... increase project_doc_max_bytes' on stderr (0.165.0 printed nothing). The model still gets no marker. gpt-6.1-sol's catalog context_window rose to 500000 while max_context_window stays 872000, so the window we set is unchanged.

Hermes v2026.9.24 (f97608f) to v0.23.2 (ae2a81c): a new tag scheme, Python 3.14 required, anthropic SDK 0.87.0 to 0.125.0, and config-file shell hooks (hooks.pre_llm_call with hooks_auto_accept) that add context to the turn's user message, which the hook arm uses. The context-file cap is still max(20000, min(context_length x 4 x 0.06, 500000)) characters unless context_file_max_chars is set (agent/prompt_builder.py:1044-1061 at the commit).
OpenClaw 2026.10.6 to 2026.11.5: engines now node >=24.16.0 <25 || >=26.1.0 (was >=24.22.1 <25); Node 24 still fits.

Hermes's installer no longer takes a tag as --branch: it requires the commit on origin/<branch>, so the frontier path's --branch <tag> fails at v0.23.2 and RulesHermes passes --branch main with the tag's commit.

OpenClaw (seen at 2026.11.5 through Harbor 0.24.0's class): openclaw setup --baseline --workspace . runs in /work/repo before Harbor copies the config that sets skipBootstrap, and writes OpenClaw's AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md and USER.md templates into the repository. RulesOpenClaw points that setup at a scratch workspace on rules jobs.

Hermes v0.23.x installs its dependencies into an environment its own package manager keeps under HERMES_HOME, not into <checkout>/venv: the frontier path's uv sync into <checkout>/venv and its HERMES_HOME=/tmp/hermes then leave hermes refusing to start ('no dependency environment is committed for this install'). RulesHermes installs with --hermes-home /tmp/hermes and adds the anthropic extra through pm.

openai:gpt-6.2-sol.source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.2-sol, read 2026-11-22 (1,050,000 context window, 128,000 max output tokens). scripts/frontier-harbor/pin.json has no row for it, so rules_wiring.overlay_frontier_pin adds this one in memory
